Description.Name: Nobility Line
Description.Details:
With the final stop before you, the Leopard zooms towards the only habitable planet in the Espia system based on the coordinates uncovered at the Linhauiguan site.

Sumire is more than aware of the hostile landscape that is notable for hosting expansive mudflats capable of swallowing whole mechs as well as entire Leopards! 

"This guy really knows how to hide stuff. No self-respecting pirate would be caught dead in a place like this!", Yang snorts.

A quaint  exposed layer of bedrock sticks out above the vast sea of mud. The middle rises into a peak resembling a failed mountain. The only thing of note is the smooth plateau large enough to land a Leopard provides Sumire just enough comfort to descend down into the dusky site. 

The familiar bay doors greet the crew as they approach the console to gain access within. Farah is gently dusting the console with her scarf in order to enter the logins.

Rubbing his hands like a cartoon villain, Yang is poised to pounce on the long-awaited Assault that quietly stands in the looming shadows within.

The lights are dimmer than the other sites making it hard to see all the way to the back of the bay. Only a hazy silhouette of a large mech can be made out.

Darius anxiously inquires, "Is it there? Can you see the Assault mech?"

Sumire grins, "Oh we can see it alright. Ha-ha!"

"Well, spit it out. The suspense is killing us!", you exclaim.

Farah hesistantly tries to breaks the news, "Well Commander, it's definitely an 80 tonne Assault mech."

Description.Name: Continue
Description.Details: Darius excitedly responds, "Congratulations, it looks like we landed ourselves an Awesome, right Yang?' Yang dejectedly answers in a voice seldom heard as he struggles to fight back tears, "It-it's a Charger boss. A GOD-DAMNED CHARGER!" "A what?!', both you and Darius shout in unison. You can overhear Farah and Sumire in the background, trying their best to stifle their laughter. Darius calmly asserts himself, "Yang, let's take a nice deep breath and see if you can find anything of note." Yang answers dejectedly, "Y-yeah, speaking of which, there is a note in the cockpit here." After collecting himself, Yang proceeds with the hand-written letter, "Congratulations! You've found the last mech in our Nobility Line as a nod to the much revered SLDF Royal units of the past. This is not a sad punchline to a sick joke! This is truly a redeemed mech, similar to its smaller cousins you have previously taken into custody. Take a moment to see its unique systems that set it apart from its humble beginnings. We also left another deposit as a sign of our appreciation for the effort you put forth to even make it this far. All the best and happy hunting, U.B." The silence prevails as Yang finally taps the buttons to activate the HUD. Slowly his frown dissolves, "Hey Commander, this is somewhat similar to the Spider with its Scout Console. This has enhanced sensors and tracking for sure. The engine wasn't touched so it's still the fastest Assault around but they gave it extra protection by adding Ferro-Fibrous armour. There are integrated features in this mech, I didn't think possible!" "Explain.", you prompt. "Well, it has a custom unit I can't seem to put my finger on. Oh yeah, it also has a built in ECM which is insane enough as it is but the real prize are the integrated Heavy Arm Mods, If this gets into striking range, it will cause almost three times the damage." Darius' jaw drops, "Almost three times the damage! Are you serious?" "Yeah, at least two and a half times the total potential melee damage. This thing can obliterate a light mech with ease and possibly cripple anything lighter than an Assault with a direct blow. This console is different and it's locked into the other unit here and I have absolutely no idea what these two weapon pods are?" After a few moments of Yang bouncing ideas off of Farah, who is also scrunched up in the cockpit next to him, "Alright, here's the deal. The cockpit is lightly reinforced. The mystery unit is serving double duty as both a melee support Gyro and a modified Close Quarters Combat ripped straight out of Vulcan. And that's not all -" "Let me guess, you were able to identify the two weapon pods?", You quip. "Indeed, Commander.", Farah smiles. "Yeah, they're RAPP cannons!", Yang holds his finger up in a give me a moment to explain myself posture. "They are Rotary Action Particle Pulse cannons. Basically, it shoots tiny PPC pulses at a high rate of fire. It has the same range of a standard small laser with almost triple the damage potential. A little more damage than a Large Laser but a little less damage than a PPC. It's absolutely insane! These are clearly prototypes and the technical readouts stored in the console warns against possible jamming due to unavoidable heat buildup. So use sparingly it says." "Sounds similar to Snub PPCs?", You quip as Yang nods in agreement. Darius ponders, "So if you couple that with the modified CQC unit then that means that all the support weapons have their maximum ranges doubled." "Exactly! This mech is the ultimate Brawler!" Sumire sighs, "And I guess that is that. It was fun while it lasted. Time to take the money and run." Darius addresses the crew, "Well done guys! Let's put all these Noble mechs to good use and earn some much needed C-Bills."
